strings.empty_desc:
No groups, components, or scenes yet.
Create an object first, then reload.
strings.about_desc: A set of SketchUp tools to speed up everyday modeling work.
strings.trial_expired_desc: Enter a license key to unlock all tools.
strings.tool_rab_desc: Quantities & cost estimate from the model
strings.rab_sub: Measure quantities from the model and build the cost estimate
strings.rab_empty: No tag has any measurable content yet. Tag your groups/components (e.g. “Brick Wall”) then click Scan Model.
strings.rab_price_note: Enter prices for your region/project; changes are saved in this model. A price of 0 means not filled in yet.
strings.rab_price_src: Prices filled from %{wilayah} (FY %{tahun} data): %{n} of %{total} items. The rest are still 0.
strings.rab_empty_mat: No material is used on any face yet. Paint faces with a material (e.g. “White Paint”) then click Scan Model.
strings.rab_warn_row_nonsolid: Some objects are not solid, their volume is not counted.
strings.rab_warn_row_manual: This unit cannot be measured from the model, enter the quantity manually.
strings.rab_warn_row_zero: Measured 0. Check the tag, the measure basis, or enter the quantity manually.
strings.rab_warn_nonsolid: %{count} objects are not solid, their volume is not counted.
strings.rab_price_more: Showing %{shown} of %{total}. Narrow it down with the search box.
strings.rab_price_none_used: No work item picked in the BOQ tab yet. Choose “All” to enter prices first.
strings.rab_warn_unpriced: %{count} base-price components are still 0, fill them in on the Base Prices tab.
strings.rab_cu_empty_edit: Pick an analysis on the left, or create a new one.
strings.rab_scan_hint: Model not scanned yet. Click Scan Model to measure quantities from the model.
strings.rab_need_scan: Click Scan Model first so quantities are measured.
strings.rab_cu_no_comps: No components yet. Add labour, materials or equipment.
strings.rab_ana_note: Pick an analysis on the left to see what it contains. You can change, add or delete the components and coefficients of any AHSP; changes are saved in this model and the original database stays untouched.
strings.rab_ana_price_tip: This base price is shared by every analysis that uses it
strings.rab_ana_modified_note: You have changed the components from the original.
strings.rab_pk_edit: Open & edit in the Analyses tab
strings.rab_src_note: Tick the AHSP files to use in this model; their analyses and base prices appear in the work picker. If two files share a code, the one higher in the list is used.
strings.rab_src_help2: jenis: upah (labour), bahan (material) or alat (equipment). Codes U.nnn (analyses) and C.nnn (base prices) belong to your own analyses, so they are skipped if present in a file.
strings.rab_src_hold: %{n} RAB rows use analyses from a file that is currently off. Their data is kept and reappears when you tick that file again.
strings.rab_src_err_json: The file is not valid JSON.
strings.rab_src_missing: This file is not on this computer. Choices that use it stay saved; untick to let go of it.
strings.rab_src_min: At least one AHSP file must stay on.
strings.rab_src_help3: Excel: the Excel button on each file exports the AHSP format (AHSP + DHSP sheets), which you can edit and add back here. To start from scratch, download the Excel template (Analisa, Komponen, Harga Dasar sheets). Only these two formats can be imported; other Excel files are rejected.
strings.rab_ana_exp_mine: My analyses → JSON (move to another model)
strings.rab_prc_note: Price lists are kept apart from analyses. Export prices to Excel from the Base Prices tab (or download the blank Excel template), fill them in there, then import here (.xlsx or .json). Matching prices replace the AHSP file's own prices; prices you type in this model always stay on top.
strings.rab_prc_none: No price lists yet. Prices come from the AHSP file.
strings.rab_prc_none_matched: no item matches the current base prices (check code / name / unit).
strings.rab_theme_tpl: Export Excel template (restyle it in Excel)
strings.rab_theme_del_confirm: Click again to delete this theme
strings.rab_theme_removed: Theme deleted; back to the built-in theme.
strings.rab_info_note: Shown above the Excel and PDF tables. Fill in only what you need; rows with an empty value are not shown.
strings.rab_info_none: No rows yet. Add one with the buttons below.
strings.rab_cp_none: No matching component. Create a new one below.
strings.rab_cp_new_name: Or create a new component — name
strings.rab_export_empty: Pick a work item for at least one tag first.
strings.trowel_sub: Push/Pull (face) & Offset (edge) inside groups without opening them
strings.trowel_s1_t: Point at a face or an edge and click
strings.trowel_s1_s: Face = Push/Pull, edge = Offset. May be inside nested groups or components, without opening them
strings.trowel_s2_t: Move the mouse or type a distance
strings.trowel_s2_s: Then click again (or Enter) to apply
strings.trowel_hint_new: Original geometry stays untouched; the result is made as a new group in the active context.
strings.trowel_hint_in: Geometry inside the group is edited directly. A component with several copies changes in all of them.
strings.trowel_hud_find_new: Point at a face (Push/Pull), may be inside a group, and click
strings.trowel_hud_find: Point at a face (Push/Pull) or an edge (Offset), may be inside a group, and click
strings.trowel_hud_hover_pp: Click to start pulling the face
strings.trowel_hud_hover_offset: Click the edge, then move the mouse toward one of the marked faces
strings.trowel_hud_drag_pp: Move the mouse or type a distance + Enter | Click a face edge = Offset | Click to apply
strings.trowel_hud_drag_offset: Offset inward / outward: move the mouse or type a distance + Enter | Click, then continue with Push/Pull
strings.trowel_hud_drag_edge: Offset line: point at any face (other groups too) | Move the mouse or type a distance + Enter | Click to apply
strings.trowel_hud_erase: Shift + click: erase this edge and the edges connected to it (count in brackets)
strings.trowel_hud_erase_no: Corner / outline edges cannot be erased (it would break the group)
strings.trowel_hud_drag: Move the mouse or type a distance + Enter | Click to apply
strings.trowel_hud_typed: Type another distance + Enter to change it | Click or empty Enter to finish
strings.trowel_s1_t_offset: Point at an edge and click
strings.trowel_s1_s_offset: Edges inside nested groups or components can be picked without opening them
strings.trowel_hud_find_offset: Point at an edge (may be inside a group) and click
strings.slice_sub: Cut groups / components with a line
strings.slice_s2_t: Draw a line in the viewport
strings.slice_hint_single: Click the start point, then the end point
strings.slice_hint_multi: Click several points to form the line
strings.slice_hud_p1: Click the start point of the cut line
strings.slice_hud_p2: Click the end point of the cut line
strings.slice_hud_align: Click a face to align the view
strings.slice_align_title: Align the view perpendicular to a face
strings.void_sub: Cutter group that makes holes in colliding groups
strings.void_s1_s: Then click Make Void (shown in translucent red)
strings.void_s2_s: All colliding solid groups get cut
strings.void_s3_t: Want a component to move along?
strings.void_s3_s: Put the component (door, window, etc.) inside the void group (double-click → paste). Only the hole shape cuts.
strings.void_none: No void groups yet. Make one first.
strings.void_live_desc: Holes update automatically when a void / group is moved
strings.void_reset_cuts_title: Close the holes of the selected voids (all voids if none selected); the voids become inactive
strings.void_all_off: All voids are inactive. Click Apply Void to activate them again.
strings.void_refresh_title: Rebuild the holes from the current void positions
strings.void_cuts_reset: %{v} void(s) deactivated, %{n} hole(s) closed. Click Apply Void to activate again.
strings.void_cuts_reset_none: %{v} void(s) deactivated. No holes needed closing.
strings.void_already_off: The selected void is already inactive.
strings.void_bake_title: Delete the hidden intact copies; results become plain groups
strings.void_bake_confirm_intro: Finalizing is permanent for the holes already made:
strings.void_bake_w1: The intact (hidden) copies of the cut groups will be DELETED.
strings.void_bake_w2: The cut groups become plain groups; the void no longer controls their holes.
strings.void_bake_w3: Moving or deleting the void will no longer change the holes, and Remove Void cannot restore the original groups.
strings.void_bake_w4: The only way to revert: Undo (Ctrl+Z) right after finalizing.
strings.purge_press_capture: Click “Capture Unused” to scan the model.
strings.lang_hint_desc: You can edit translations or add new language files (.json) in the language folder.
strings.mail_open: Open Gmail in the browser (choose a Google account)
strings.wa_request: I would like to buy a Boosok Tools license.
strings.about_send_hwid_prefix: Send your name, phone number, and proof of payment to email:
strings.about_send_hwid_suffix: to receive your license key. Price = Rp25,000.
strings.lic_err_device_limit: This key is already used on {n} devices. Release the old device via License > Remove activation, or contact the author.
strings.lic_err_revoked: This key has been revoked. Contact the author.
strings.lic_err_network: Cannot reach the license server. Check your internet connection and try again.
strings.lic_err_bad_response: Invalid server response. Try again later.
strings.lic_success_toast: License successfully activated! All tools unlocked.
strings.email_request: I would like to request a license key for Boosok Tools.
strings.cs_sub1_hover: Click to select Level | Hold click & drag to box-select
strings.cs_sub1_exit: Hold click & drag: box select | ESC : Exit
strings.cs_sub2_hover: (Hold) CTRL + Scroll: Change group Level depth | ESC: Exit
strings.cs_sub1_window: Window: only objects fully inside the box | Drag left for Crossing
strings.cs_sub1_crossing: Crossing: every object the box touches | Drag right for Window
strings.cs_model_empty: Select Tool: Model is empty. Create an object / group first.
strings.cs_hover_empty: Select Tool: Hover over a group/component to change level.
strings.cs_status_lvl_active: Select Tool [Level %{lvl} Active]: Hover over an object | [ESC] Reset to Level 0
strings.cs_status_idle: Select Tool: Hover over an object | [CTRL + Scroll] Select nested level | [Click] Select
strings.cs_status_hover: Select Tool [Level %{lvl}/%{max}: %{name}]: [Click] Select | [CTRL + Scroll] Change Level | [ESC] Reset
strings.upd_installing_msg: Please wait, do not close SketchUp.
strings.upd_done_msg: Plugin is active, no need to restart SketchUp.
strings.tool_disabled_toast: This feature is temporarily disabled. Please try again later.
strings.sel_sub: Select objects by tag, name & attribute
strings.repl_sub: Replace objects, size follows old or new
strings.deep_no_material: No other materials in the model.
strings.scene_sub: Manage tag & object visibility per scene
strings.sel_not_found_msg: No objects found matching the given criteria.
strings.err_not_ready: Function not ready. Please try again.
strings.sel_geo_desc: Also select edges / faces that have a tag
strings.clean_step3_s: Tag & position preserved, other instances safe
strings.clean_note: Select one or more groups / components in the model first.
strings.clean_err: Group Cleaner function not ready. Please try again.
strings.repl_size_old_d: The new item is scaled to match the size of the old item.
strings.repl_size_new_d: The new item keeps its own size; only the old item’s position & rotation are used.
strings.repl_old_s1_s: One or more groups / components to replace
strings.repl_old_s2_s: Selection will be cleared for the next step
strings.repl_note1: Select Tools active — use Ctrl+Scroll in viewport to select nested groups.
strings.repl_new_s2_s: Tag & name follow the old item; size per the option below
strings.repl_note2: Select Tools active — use Ctrl+Scroll to select nested groups as new item.
strings.repl_note1_native: Select objects with the SketchUp built-in Select tool.
strings.repl_note2_native: Select the new item objects with the SketchUp built-in Select tool.
strings.reset_preserve_d: Scale becomes 1:1:1 without changing current dimensions (scaled size is kept).
strings.reset_original_d: Scale becomes 1:1:1 and dimensions revert to original before scaling.
strings.untag_recursive_d: Also process nested group / component contents
strings.untag_hint: Select group / component in model first
strings.deep_empty: Select objects in SketchUp then click Scan Objects.
strings.scene_isolate: Isolate selected objects in active scene
strings.scene_obj_note: Select Tools automatically activates when Objects tab is selected — use Ctrl+Scroll in viewport to select nested groups.
strings.scene_empty: This model does not have any scenes yet.
strings.upd_latest_sub: Boosok Tools {ver} is already up to date.
strings.upd_keep_working: You can continue working, this window will notify when finished.
strings.upd_done_sub_restart: installed. Restart SketchUp to activate the new version.
strings.upd_done_hint: If any feature windows are currently open, please close and reopen them.
